Summarise a catchmentACS run result

Source: R/run.R
summary.cacs_run_result.Rd

Custom summary method for the cacs_run_result S3 class returned by cacs_run(). It mirrors the summary.lm pattern by returning a structured S3 list (cacs_run_summary) with its own print method. The summary records the run metadata; the row, site, variable, and drive-time tallies; a five-number summary of n_tracts; a per-rate breakdown (mean, standard deviation, and count of missing values grouped by rate variable); and the overall rate at which the margin of error (MOE) fell back to a default.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'cacs_run_result'
summary(object, ..., breakdown = c("cross_site", "per_site", "both"))

Arguments

object

A cacs_run_result, as returned by cacs_run().

...

Currently unused (reserved for future filter arguments).

breakdown

One of "cross_site" (the default), "per_site", or "both". Controls what print.cacs_run_summary() shows: the returned list always carries both the rates_breakdown slot (cross-site collapse) and the rates_per_site / rates_per_site_moe slots (a wide rate matrix keyed by site_id and, when present, drive_time_min) regardless.

Value

A cacs_run_summary list (class c("cacs_run_summary", "list")).

See also

cacs_run(), print.cacs_run_summary(), cacs_summary_as_markdown(), cacs_describe().

Other result summaries: as_tibble.cacs_run_result(), cacs_describe(), cacs_summary_as_markdown(), group_by.cacs_run_result(), print.cacs_run_result(), print.cacs_run_summary()
